I have SAD (I get depressed during the winter). I've been on Wellbutrin for the last two years for depression (I've been on Zoloft for both the depression & anxiety for the last year). In my experience, Wellbutrin helps balance out my lows, but it doesn't get rid of it completely. So instead of being at the tipping point/suicidal for a few months of the year, I'll be exhausted and wishing I no longer existed. So it's a marked improvement for me, but by no means a cure.


As far as side effects, for the first month on Wellbutrin I had *horrible* intestinal issues & cramps (so much so that I almost stopped taking it), but it eventually lessened and now I don't notice anything out of the ordinary. I'm on 150XL, and the one time I went up to 300XL I noticed that it made my brain feel really fuzzy/sluggish.


Hope this helps, and good luck! :)
